targets: signed D/U0; other E,W,I,energy,gap,spectra are measured companions, not equated with scalar x
time_mapping: ball time = 20*fluid time, fixed using training period0.2->4; other frequencies use ball period20*P without refitting time scale
initial_mapping: x0=sign*0.1; predicted D/U0 = initial D/U0 + k*(x-x0), with k>=0 fitted only to low-amplitude training curve
held_out: A0.5 atP0.2 and0.1, both mirrored signs, 65-grid strong control and half-step control; training mirror is only symmetry validation
baselines: training-fitted linear change in physical time
primary_score: Relative L2 over0..0.4 against measured D/U0; 10percent exploratory screen; compare scores to both simpler baselines
no_retrofit: Keep r,c,time map and fit rules fixed when held-out data arrive. Failed prediction remains a result.
other_layers: Four-node, listening and spatial symmetry checks are structural comparisons. No quantitative coupling/feedback/diffusion mapping to Navier-Stokes has been established.
